target.name: target_flood_exposure
target.description: Indicates whether a road segment intersects an active riverine flood hazard corridor (within 2,500m of an overflowing CWC river gauging reach). Does NOT imply confirmed direct pavement submergence or road closure.

features.name: rainfall_24h_mm
features.derivation: Precipitation accumulated during the 24 hours up to observation time at road centroid

features.name: rainfall_72h_mm
features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Forecast / IMD Real-Time API (past 72h accumulation)
features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation accumulated during the 72 hours (3 days) up to observation date at road centroid

features.name: rainfall_7d_mm
features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Forecast / IMD Real-Time API (past 7d accumulation)
features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation accumulated during the 7 days up to observation date at road centroid

features.name: upstream_rainfall_72h_mm
features.historical_source: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 Reanalysis) at upstream gauge/catchment inlet
features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API queried at upstream catchment centroid
features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation over the 72 hours preceding observation date at the upstream hydrological inlet/gauge

features.name: temperature_c
features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Real-Time Weather API / In-Vehicle OAT Sensor
features.derivation: Daily mean surface air temperature at 2m above ground

features.name: wind_speed_kmh
features.derivation: Daily maximum wind speed at 10m above ground

features.name: relative_elevation_m
features.real_time_source: Pre-indexed river channel DEM datum lookup by road segment coordinate
features.derivation: road_elevation_m minus static_river_channel_datum_m (relative vertical clearance above regional drainage)

features.name: road_type
features.real_time_source: Local OSM Highway Tag / Route Metadata

features.name: road_surface
features.real_time_source: Local OSM Surface Tag / Municipal GIS Layer
features.derivation: Pavement material specification (BT = Bituminous, CC = Cement Concrete)

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: road_length_m
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Phase 12 demonstrated that road_length_m acts as an exact 1-to-1 surrogate for road identity, causing severe spatial memorization and distractor noise. Removing it improved unseen-road ROC-AUC from 0.7556 to 0.8459.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: elevation_m
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Absolute elevation above sea level is heavily confounded with basin identity (Godavari at 50m vs Deccan plateau at 500m). Superseded by relative_elevation_m.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: distance_to_flood_m
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Direct spatial component of the ground-truth label definition.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: gauge_water_level_m
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Concurrent event water level used to trigger the flood exposure label.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: gauge_warning_level_m
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Static threshold used to define flood event initiation.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: flood_stage
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Event severity tier directly derived from gauge water level.

excluded_and_quarantined_variables.name: spatial_evidence_type
excluded_and_quarantined_variables.reason: Annotation metadata denoting negative control or proximity proxy.

future_unsupported_features.name: upstream_discharge
future_unsupported_features.reason: Hourly upstream volumetric river discharge (cumecs) requires real-time CWC/FFWC telemetry integration not currently accessible.

future_unsupported_features.name: stage_change_rate
future_unsupported_features.reason: Requires sub-daily antecedent river gauge timeseries at t-6h, t-12h. Not available in daily historical catalogs.
